input.description:
Invoke when the user asks about sell-through performance, weekly sell-through percent, or regional sales trends for a SKU. Examples: 'How is BRH-2240 selling in Texas?', 'Show weekly sell-through by region for the Branchwood 3-Cube shelf'.

Stub tool for sales-inventory-mcp. Returns weekly sell-through % by region (and per-store trend) for a SKU. Deterministic canned data for the WoW 2026 demo - not connected to live systems.
